content.rationale: S5-marker-append fixes what closing a bracket does to the state — the (pre, post) pair appended in run order, the position moved to the pair's post-boundary, the undone count cleared and the bound standing — and S5-ordered that marker order is the order operations ran in; M-layout places the module flat at src/markers_append.rs. It names the state through M-markers' closed types, crosses the store through M-store, and reads and writes the whole file through M-markers-persist's load and save — never std::fs, never a truncate. One transition: read the live state, push the pair at the end, move the position to the pair's post-boundary, clear the undone count, leave the bound standing, write the file back; every failure is M-markers-persist's carried reason, and this module never renders it.
